notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3.0.6
notes.notes: [p]Hello Survivors![/p][p][/p][p]A new patch is available for the demo of Dead in Antares, bringing some bugfixing![/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player can't assign any worker on any station after unlocking a character[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock when pressing the ctrl key during an expedition[/p][/*][*][p]Deactivated the condition popup button and the natural resources popup by night to prevent some bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Deactivated the arrow shortcuts by night to prevent some bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the "Immortality Withdrawal" trait from the pool of negative trait that could be gained during the night (this trait was not supposed to be here)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Don't forget to update your game![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo patch 0.3.0.5
notes.notes: [p]Hello survivors![/p][p][/p][p]A patch for the demo of Dead in Antares is now available![/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could lose a character recently unlocked after quitting without saving or after a game over[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on unidentified items that could be used on a character[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the fatigue increase during exploration[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the energy [b]consumption [/b]preview feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos and tags in the tutorial text[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash occurring when two characters were at the infirmary station while another station was consuming some energy[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Don't forget to update your game![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2511800/partnerevents/preview/502834694432227804"]Preview Event[/url][/p]
